Maya (PM): Quick ping for PMR-2026-07 action list — a couple of items show overdue in the tracker. Can owners confirm status or reassign? Need firm ETAs by EOD Fri. @Lena @Ravi

Lena (SRE): Ack. I'm on AI-4 (tunable cache eviction) but got pulled onto a live incident yesterday. I'll unblock today and have a design patch by tomorrow. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Ravi (Platform): AI-5 (deploy gating + alert thresholds) is half-done. Waiting on infra flags from Eli to flip during canary. ETA depends on that.

Eli (Eng Infra): Sorry, I saw this late. I can provision the feature flag toggles but need the YAML config from Ravi. If Ravi drops the config snippet I can enable a test flag in staging today.

Maya (PM): Copy. Can we put the outstanding items inline?

```
PMR-2026-07 action items (current):
AI-4: tunable cache eviction + SLO notes — owner: Lena — status: blocked -> unblocked — ETA: ?
AI-5: deploy gating + alert thresholds — owner: Ravi — status: waiting on infra flags — ETA: ?
AI-6: retrospective trend analysis automation — owner: Maya — status: in progress — ETA: 2026-04-05
```

Maya (PM): Please update ETAs directly. If still no firm ETA by EOD Fri I'll escalate to Eng leads.

sre-bot: Reminder: 2 overdue actions for PMR-2026-07. Escalation scheduled in 36h. :warning:

Ravi (Platform): Dropped config in thread: 

```yaml
# deploy gating thresholds
alerts:
  latency_p95: 1200ms
  error_rate: 0.5%
```

Eli (Eng Infra): Got it. Flag created in staging: feature/pmr-2026-07-gating. I'll coordinate canary windows tomorrow.

Lena (SRE): Update: design patch opened: https://git.redwood/PR/4880 — adds eviction knobs and SLO docs. Request review from @Eli and @Ravi. ETA merge: 2026-04-02 EOD.

Ravi (Platform): Confirmed I reviewed the YAML and adjusted alert thresholds. I'll run the gating canary once Eli enables the flag. Updated ETA for AI-5: 2026-04-03.

Maya (PM): Great. Two asks: 1) when canary completes please post a short verification note here (service, metric checked, time). 2) add the verification tag to the PMR ticket so it auto-closes.

Eli (Eng Infra): Canary window scheduled 2026-04-03 10:00-11:00 UTC. I'll monitor infra metrics and will post verification in this thread.

Lena (SRE): Merged PR and runbook updated. Will monitor cache hit rate during canary.

sre-bot: Tracker updated: AI-4 -> in review; AI-5 -> canary scheduled; next escalation: none. :white_check_mark:

Maya (PM): Thanks all. Closing action: I'll run the trend automation next week and circle back if anything regresses. If anyone hits a blocker, @mention me and I'll reprioritize. :thumbsup:
